name: Ubstadt-Weiher (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ubstadt-Weiher (a white cross on blue and an orb on white).
history: Municipal flag of Ubstadt-Weiher; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
